Subject: Request: NovaRetail vendor intake — marketplace procurement questionnaire

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking a look — attached is the marketplace vendor intake questionnaire we need completed for NovaRetail to proceed with listing and procurement approval across our AWS and Azure catalogs. The worksheet covers metering, entitlements, billing flows, SLA commitments, and security evidence.

Key dates: we need the completed workbook back by COB Wednesday Oct 6 so our procurement team can start legal review the week of Oct 12.

A few quick clarifications we need up front:
- Confirm whether billing will be metered via marketplace (AWS/Azure) or invoiced directly to NovaRetail.
- Describe your SKU model for multi-tenant marketplace listings (subscription vs usage vs seat).
- Provide contact for SOC2 / security evidence and an expected delivery date for any attestation docs.

I've copied our vendor ops inbox in case there are internal listing steps we should coordinate.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaRetail

Hi Samir — thanks for the questionnaire. We'll take the workbook and return a completed version ahead of your Oct 6 deadline.

Laura, Ben, Neha — looping you in to lead specific sections:
- Laura: commercial/pricing and marketplace SKU model.
- Ben: metering/billing integrations and marketplace metering compliance.
- Neha: security evidence (SOC 2, data residency notes, logging/audit attachments).

Plan:
1) Internal kickoff today — review the spreadsheet and tag items for legal/SRE where needed.
2) Draft answers and attachments by Oct 3 for internal review.
3) Finalize and deliver back to Samir by Oct 5 (so they have a buffer).

Samir — quick answers to your clarifications so the team can prioritize:
- Primary billing model: Marketplace-mediated metering for AWS and Azure where possible; for enterprise customers (annual reserved/dedicated capacity) we offer invoiced options and reserved SKUs.
- SKU model: We support both subscription SKUs (monthly flat fee for Dedicated) and usage SKUs (per-token/embedding unit) — we can provide example SKU naming and a mapping table.
- Security contact: Neha will own delivery of SOC2 artifacts and the attestation summary; expect a preliminary bundle by Oct 3 and the full report link by Oct 9.

We'll attach a consolidated PDF with answers and supporting evidence.

Best,
Michael Grant
VP Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

Michael (and team),

Attached are my section responses and a pricing sketch (redwood_pricing_estimate_oct2026.xlsx). Summary highlights:

- Billing & Metering:
  * For AWS/Azure marketplace: we recommend native marketplace metering for discovery and simple consumption flows. Marketplace handles metered billing for per-unit (token/embedding) usage; we will report usage via the provider-specific metering APIs (we already support AWS Marketplace Metering Service and Azure Marketplace metering APIs).
  * For customers who require reserved/dedicated capacity (e.g., enterprise contracts), we offer invoiced SKUs and monthly committed usage lines which are not routed through marketplace billing.
  * Mapping approach: usage SKU names include model-version-region (e.g., rwlledger-gen-1-usw2-usage) and subscription SKU names include plan and capacity unit (e.g., redwood-dedicated-16g-std-monthly).

- SKUs & Pricing Model:
  * Supported SKU types: metered-usage, subscription (monthly), and seat-based (rare).
  * Pricing examples are in the attached spreadsheet. We provide both MSRP and a NovaRetail-specific channel discount tier if they want consolidated marketplace listing pricing.

- Marketplace Entitlements & Fulfillment:
  * Entitlements are tied to marketplace purchase tokens where possible; for invoiced/reserved deals, we provision entitlements via our internal licensing service and sync to NovaRetail's tenancy.

- SLA & Support:
  * Standard hosted API SLA: 99.9% availability with defined latency percentiles per model. Dedicated contracts can include 99.95% and higher depending on commitment.
  * Support: standard tier (business hours), premium (24/7 with priority routing). We can include SRE contact for escalation during onboarding window.

- Security Evidence:
  * SOC 2 Type II report: available. I will coordinate with Neha to attach the summary and a link to the full report (redwood_rfp_answers_v2.pdf will include the evidence links).
  * Data residency: We list supported regions (US, EU, APAC) and can offer VPC/private deployments for regulated customers.

I'll incorporate Ben/Neha's input on metering and security attachment references and produce the consolidated RFP PDF.

Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_oct2026.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Samir — attaching our completed questionnaire and supporting evidence. Thank you for the clear checklist; we aimed to make the answers prescriptive to speed review.

What we attached:
- redwood_rfp_answers_v2.pdf (consolidated responses to the NovaRetail workbook; includes links to SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, and SKU mapping)
- redwood_pricing_estimate_oct2026.xlsx (pricing examples and channel discount tiers)

Key notes for procurement review:
- Metering: For NovaRetail's preferred path (marketplace-mediated billing), Redwood will push usage events using provider metering APIs. This ensures NovaRetail receives marketplace invoices and preserves marketplace commission flows. For customers opting for reserved capacity or committed spend, we will invoice directly and provide entitlement tokens to the NovaRetail tenancy.
- AWS vs Azure differences: integration points differ slightly (AWS uses the Marketplace Metering Service; Azure uses the Azure Commerce metering APIs). Our engineering team has implemented both and maintains test harnesses for provider certification.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2 Type II summary included; full attestation will be provided via secure link to the NovaRetail security team by Oct 9.
- Next steps: please confirm whether NovaRetail prefers marketplace billing for the pilot. If yes, we will share final SKU list + onboarding docs and kick off the marketplace technical onboarding with your vendor-ops team (we typically schedule a 60-minute integration call to validate metering and entitlement provisioning).

If procurement/legal want a redlined commercial term before legal review, we can provide a short SOW and channel addendum. Link to draft SOW and onboarding checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_sow

Best regards,
Michael Grant
VP Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference
